$IWM

Federal Reserve inflation policy context (Beth Hammack, Cleveland Fed): Now is the time to act on inflation. Policy isn't restrictive enough; longer delays make disinflation more expensive. Real-world consequences highlighted (insurance premiums up, wages inadequate for cost increases).

Context: May reference small-cap (Russell 2000) sensitivity to Fed policy stance on rate trajectory.
